name: Electoral College
rules: Two players compete in a Cambridge Vice-Chancellor election across 12 colleges, each with a specified number of Fellows. Each player simultaneously allocates up to 100 pennies among the colleges, using non-negative integers. Each college awards exactly one electoral vote to the higher donor regardless of its number of Fellows; tied donations award no vote. The player with more electoral votes wins; equal totals result in a draw. Invalid allocations automatically lose; if both allocations are invalid, the game is a draw.
